record.title: Armenia–Azerbaijan longstanding closure of ordinary transport links
record.scope: Ordinary direct interstate road/rail links, including Nakhchivan connections

record.uncertainty: 1991 means complete transport interruption by that year, not exact original closure date; sporadic restrictions began 1989. Territorial control changed, so no single unchanged physical line implied.
